content_sections.heading: AAU Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidates who are permanent residents of Assam should only apply for the posts of Assistant Professor & equivalent.

rows.post: Assistant Professor & equivalent (Other than Agro-meteorology, Agril. Statistics, ABM, Computer Science & Food Science & Technology)
rows.qualification_required: Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture/ Horticulture/ Community Science/Veterinary Science as relevant to the requirement of the post. For the post of Assistant Professor in Sericulture, the essential requirement is Bachelor’s degree in either Sericulture or Agriculture. Secured minimum 55% marks or minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (MCGPA) of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in the discipline relevant to the post from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified National Eligibility Test (NET), or NET is waived for candidates with Ph.D. degree obtained under course credit system as per UGC Regulations, 2009, provided the candidate has at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5 on the last date of submission of application. A minimum score (44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST) as stipulated in the 'Academic Performance Indicator' (API) based 'Performance Based Appraisal System' (PBAS) is required to be called for interview.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Science with Physics or Meteorology as the major subject OR Passed Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture/Veterinary Science/Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Meteorology/Agricultural Meteorology from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture/ Veterinary Science/ Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry/ Agricultural Engineering. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Business Administration from an Indian university or a foreign university. OR MBA/PGDM from reputed institutions like IIM with two years working experience in reputed organization. Qualified NET (where applicable) or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Science with Statistics as major subject OR Passed Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture/Veterinary Science/Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Statistics/Agricultural Statistics from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Application/ Information Technology/ Engineering/ Science with Computer Science as major subject. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Computer Application/ Information Technology/ Information & Communication Technology/ Computer Engineering/ Electronics & Communication Engineering/ Computer Science from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Science or equivalent degree relevant to the post. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in disciplines of Food Technology/Food Science & Technology/ Food Engineering/Dairy Technology/Post Harvest Technology/Agricultural Process Engineering or equivalent disciplines from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

content_sections.heading: AAU Assistant Professor Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the post of Assistant Professor & equivalent is 38 years as on the last date of submission of the application.

rows.relaxation: By number of full years of service rendered in AAU/ICAR/CSIR/DST/SAUs and other Govt. Institutions up to a maximum of 5 (five) years as supported by relevant documents, as per existing norms of AAU and Govt. of Assam.
As per norms of the Govt. of Assam. The percentage of disability for PWD candidates shall be as per Govt. norms.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assam Agricultural University (AAU) is conducting the recruitment under Advertisement No. 4/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for AAU Assistant Professor & equivalent recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 60 vacancies are available, comprising 50 under the Faculty of Agriculture and 10 under the Faculty of Community Science.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for AAU Assistant Professor 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 4 November 2026 up to 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 1000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SC, ST, and PWD candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST/PWD candidates is Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q6. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Permanent residents of Assam possessing the requisite Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent MCGPA), NET/Ph.D. qualifications, and meeting the discipline-specific criteria can apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for AAU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 38 years as on the last date of submission of the application, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories and in-service candidates as per norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for AAU Assistant Professor & equivalent posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Rs. 57,700 - 1,82,400/- (Level 10 in Pay Matrix, 7th Pay Commission).

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website at www.aau.ac.in.
